name: Smart TTS
summary: A smart text to speech engine for blind people: Urdu, Hindi and English in the right voice, built-in Reed voice, backup voices, and now settings for each app.
whatsNew: What's new in version 1.4 - Fixed: Google Play Protect no longer warns about Smart TTS - New: Backup and restore your settings and dictionary - New: Dash between numbers, read as "to", "minus", "dash" or a short pause - New: Hold the phone to your ear to hear speech privately - New: Keep speech on the phone while Bluetooth audio is connected - New: Shake the phone twice to copy what was just said - New: Settings for each app, with its own speed, pitch, volume and voice
